intro: かわりに (代わりに) is a swap: one thing takes the place of another. Either the expected thing is replaced (instead of X), or one thing is given in return for another (in exchange for X). After a noun it needs の: 父のかわりに.

skills.rule: Noun + の + かわりに, or a plain-form clause + かわりに: instead of X, in X's place, or in exchange for X.
skills.explain:
Substitution: noun + の + かわりに. 父のかわりに私が行きます means my father does not go; I go in his place. 砂糖のかわりにはちみつを使う: honey replaces sugar. With a verb in the plain non-past form it means doing one thing instead of another: 電車に乗るかわりに歩いた. At the start of a sentence, その代わり(に) means 'instead' or 'in return'.

Exchange: [A] かわりに [B] can also mean B is the price paid for A, or compensates for it: 英語を教えるかわりに日本語を教えてもらう. With adjectives it gives a trade-off: この部屋は狭いかわりに家賃が安い (small, but cheap to make up for it). な-adjectives keep な: 静かなかわりに.

The edge: something must actually be replaced or traded. のために is 'for the sake of' and replaces nobody: 父のために行く means you go for his benefit. として is 'in the role of'.
patterns: [clause A] かわりに [clause B in return]

examples.jp: 砂糖[さとう]の{かわりに}はちみつを使[つか]います。
examples.en: I use honey instead of sugar.

examples.jp: 今日[きょう]は父[ちち]の{かわりに}私[わたし]が会議[かいぎ]に出[で]ます。
examples.en: Today I'm attending the meeting in my father's place.

examples.jp: 雨[あめ]だったので、公園[こうえん]に行[い]く{かわりに}家[いえ]で映画[えいが]を見[み]ました。
examples.en: It was raining, so instead of going to the park we watched a film at home.

examples.jp: 英語[えいご]を教[おし]える{かわりに}、日本語[にほんご]を教[おし]えてもらっています。
examples.en: In exchange for teaching English, I get taught Japanese.

examples.jp: この部屋[へや]は狭[せま]い{かわりに}、家賃[やちん]が安[やす]いです。
examples.en: This room is small, but the rent is cheap to make up for it.

contrast.note: 父のために料理を作る: cook for my father (he eats it). 父のかわりに料理を作る: cook in his place (he would normally cook).
通訳として参加する: take part in the role of interpreter. Nobody is replaced; with かわりに someone else would have been there.
のおかげで credits a cause for a good result (thanks to). It has nothing to do with replacing or trading.

mistakes.bad: 父[ちち]{かわりに}私[わたし]が行[い]きます。
mistakes.good: 父[ちち]の{かわりに}私[わたし]が行[い]きます。
mistakes.note: After a noun, かわりに needs の.

mistakes.bad: この辺[へん]は静[しず]か{かわりに}、少[すこ]し不便[ふべん]です。
mistakes.good: この辺[へん]は静[しず]かな{かわりに}、少[すこ]し不便[ふべん]です。
mistakes.note: A な-adjective keeps な before かわりに.

skills.tip: Can you say 'in X's place' or 'in return for X'? Then かわりに. If it is 'for X's benefit', it is のために.
